(1) **No.** The surfaces appear as flat, low-resolution textures applied to simple block geometry (voxel-style). There is no realistic relief, depth, or physical grain; the wood and concrete look like 2D decals on flat planes.
(2) **No.** The environment is clean with no missing textures, black patches, z-fighting, holes, or visible geometry bugs.
(3) **3/10**; the weakest surface is the **wooden crates** (repetitive, flat texture with no detail or variation).
